title: Long-Context Drafting Does Not Require Long-Context Drafters
abstract: arXiv:2610.20865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding pairs a cheap drafter with parallel verification against the target. At ultra-long context it stops paying, because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, so the speedup it was meant to provide first erodes and then reverses. The standard response is to build a long-context drafter, by training or fine-tuning one, or by using a multi-token-prediction head shipped inside the target checkpoint. We argue this is unnecessary, because the drafters in use are target-conditioned, reading hidden states the target computed over the entire prefix, so distant context already reaches them without their own attention, and verification corrects what they miss. We therefore freeze released short-context drafters and run them far past their training length under two inference-time mechanisms, one bounding the attention cache they see, which fixes their cost, and one re-basing their

translated_title: 长上下文草稿生成无需长上下文草稿模型
translated_abstract: 投机解码将一个廉价的草稿模型与针对目标模型的并行验证相结合。在超长上下文场景下，它不再划算，因为一个对完整前缀执行注意力计算的草稿模型会继承目标模型随上下文变化的计算成本，因此它本应提供的加速先是逐渐被侵蚀，随后甚至发生逆转。标准的应对方案是构建一个长上下文草稿模型——通过训练或微调获得，或者使用目标模型检查点中自带的多词元预测头。我们认为这是不必要的，因为现有使用的草稿模型都是以目标模型为条件的：它们读取的是目标模型在整个前缀上计算出的隐藏状态，因此遥远的上下文无需草稿模型自身的注意力机制就已经能够传递给它们，而验证过程则会纠正它们遗漏的内容。因此，我们冻结已发布的短上下文草稿模型，并在两种推理时机制下使其运行远超其训练长度：一种机制限制它们所看到的注意力缓存，从而固定其成本；另一种机制对其进行重定基处理……
tldr: 长上下文投机解码无需构建长上下文草稿模型——通过限制注意力缓存和重定基两种推理时机制，现成的短上下文草稿模型即可远超其训练长度高效运行，因为草稿模型借助目标模型的隐藏状态已经能感知遥远上下文。
en_tdlr: Long-context speculative decoding does not require long-context drafters: frozen short-context drafters can run far beyond their training length via inference-time mechanisms (bounding attention cache and re-basing), since target-conditioned drafters already receive distant context through the target's hidden states.
